audit.why: TRICKY 7/10: she owns pre-6 range, his 6-and-first-item window is lethal, late swings back — the 46.12% WR reflects how punishing his window is.

audit.whatIsWrong: Layer disagreements on five rows, plus content contradicting itself: win[4] said Taliyah at 6 while spikes[1], mid and the (misplaced) whys[5] all say Death Mark flips the lane at 6; whys[5] described level 6 while sitting on the first-item row.
audit.why: Kit adjudication: Death Mark at 6 is his kill window against an immobile mage — content's own prose says so three times. First item (lethality) extends the window until her Zhonya's; late is hers (anti-dash W, Worked Ground, cross-map R).
audit.corrected: Chart now Taliyah 0-3, Zed 4-5, Taliyah 6 in both layers; whys rewritten to match, whys[5] reframed to first item. This also softens the packet defect (chart vs 46.12% WR).

audit.whatIsWrong: Death Mark's untargetability on cast never stated in full layer; Living Shadow's 20s cooldown as the trade window absent; phases[1] rewrite avoids implying minions block his Q (they reduce, not block).
audit.why: Zed kit: R flag untargetable, W cd 20/19/18/17/16, Q cd 6.
audit.corrected: Untargetable-on-cast and the 20s shadow window written into report[5] and breakdown.cooldowns.
Death Mark 120s, Living Shadow 20s, her W 14s stated.

audit.whatIsWrong: Copy-paste bleed in dosFull[1].d and dontsFull[2].d; unsourced 'TP doubles' magnitude in report[7].t.
audit.corrected: Rewritten to match titles; magnitude removed.

edits.after: Level 1 your Q double-cast out-ranges and out-repeats his 6-second Razor Shuriken — he eats rocks on every last-hit.

edits.after: Taliyah

edits.before: W online: the shove-displacement already threatens kill angles against overstep-happy laners.
edits.after: At 2 keep poking — his only ranged answer is a 6s-cooldown shuriken you can sidestep at range.

edits.after: Taliyah

edits.before: Full kit: W-into-E is the signature burst — shove him across the stones and watch half a health bar disappear.
edits.after: Full kit: the instant Living Shadow flies out, W him back and E his landing spot — the swap detonates your mines.

edits.after: Taliyah

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — Q-poke on every wave contact. Fresh-ground positioning is your real skill expression now.
edits.after: Lost Chapter timing — your range and W-E peel keep him zoned; his pressure comes from leaving lane, so deny it.

edits.before: Weaver's Wall online — you are now the best roaming mid in the game. Every shove is a bot-lane gank announcement.
edits.after: Death Mark flips the lane at 6: the W-R shadow burst kills through your peel — hold Flash or Wall for it alone.

edits.after: Zed

edits.after: Level 6 tips to Zed: Death Mark plus shadow-swap burst kills through your W peel.

edits.after: Zed

edits.before: Luden's spike: the W-E-Q rotation deletes squishies. Force river fights where your stones pre-seed the geometry.
edits.after: First item keeps his window open: lethality turns Death Mark lethal through peel until your Zhonya's timing lands.

edits.before: Level 6 tips to Zed: Death Mark plus a shadow-Q-E combo can burst you through W and peel.

edits.after: Taliyah

edits.before: Late Taliyah edits maps: wall their reinforcements, shove their frontline into your team, and Q whatever stands on stones.
edits.after: Late you reclaim it: Worked Ground zoning, W-airborne on his dash-ins and cross-map R picks — group and he can't isolate you.

edits.before: - Zed Death Mark: matchup-defining — The all-in — spend your defensive answer AFTER the mark lands, not before. Check it before every step-up. - W Seismic Shove is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it. - The ult answers fights, not waves.
edits.after: - Death Mark is 120s at rank 1 — spend Zhonya's or Wall AFTER the mark lands, not before. - Living Shadow is 20s: when it's down he has no engage and no escape, so that is your trade window. - Your 14s W is the lifeline; chip damage never gets it.

edits.before: Q from fresh ground on his last-hit, and if he steps to answer, W-shove him across the E-field — the full geometry trade is half a health bar.
edits.after: The instant he swaps to his shadow, W him backward through your mines — the stun lands mid-combo and his Death Mark window closes early.

edits.before: Trading while standing on your own Worked Ground — one-stone Qs lose every exchange your positioning already conceded.
edits.after: With W down you have no anti-dash answer — his 5s Shadow Slash and passive bite hardest at melee, exactly where he wants you.

edits.before: Track Zed’s Death Mark: The all-in — spend your defensive answer AFTER the mark lands, not before. The whole green-light system is its cooldown.
edits.after: Death Mark makes him untargetable on cast — spend Zhonya's or Wall AFTER the mark lands. Living Shadow down (20s) is your green light.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP doubles the roam thesis; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you intend to roam.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport or Ignite — TP extends the roam plan cross-map; Ignite converts the W-E burst into early deletions. Pick by how hard you intend to roam.
